description: There was no drama left to wring out of this final, only a coronation, and Cedevita Olimpija staged it in the last place their rivals would have wanted. The Ljubljana club closed out a 3-0 sweep of Krka with an 87-71 win before 500 spectators at the Leon Stuklja Hall on Sunday, claiming a sixth consecutive Slovenian title and the 23rd of the independent era the first time in their history they have lifted the championship trophy in the heart of Novo Mesto.

title: Cedevita Olimpija hold off Krka to earn Liga Nova KBM title
description: Cedevita Olimpija - Krka 72-65 Cedevita Olimpija celebrated the fifth straight Liga Nova KBM title. They beat Krka in the fourth game of the championship series to defend the title. Brynton Lemar (193-SG-1995, college: UC Davis) finished with 16 points to pace the winners. Krka looked solid in the first half. The visitors set the tone early as they eked out a 19-17 lead after ten minutes. Krka extended the lead to 5 points at halftime 38-33. But Cedevita Olimpija erased the deficit in the third period. They tied things up at 53 heading into the fourth quarter. Cedevita Olimpija then went on a strong 19-12 run in the final period to ice the victory. Aleksej Nikolic (191-PG-1995) provided 14 points for the winners. Niko Bacvic (191-PG-1997) answered with 17 points, while Jaka Klobucar (199-G-2003) netted 14 points for Krka.

title: Cedevita Olimpija celebrate Liga Nova KBM title
description: Cedevita Ol. - Helios Suns 99-71 Cedevita Olimpija claimed Liga Nova KBM title. They stormed past Helios Suns in Game 4 of the championship series to lift the trophy. The game without a history. Cedevita Ol. led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. They dominated down low during the game scoring 54 of its points in the paint compared to Helios Suns' 30. They outrebounded Helios Suns 42-19 including a 13-2 advantage in offensive rebounds. The former international swingman Zoran Dragic (196-1989) fired 21 points and 8 rebounds for the winners. The former international center Alen Omic (216-1992) chipped in a double-double by scoring 16 points and 10 rebounds (on 7-of-9 shooting from the field). title: Cedevita Olimpija celebrate Liga Nova KBM title
description: Cedevita Ol. - Krka 80-68 Cedevita Olimpija celebrated Liga Nova KBM title. They overcame Krka in the third game of the championship series to complete the sweep. The game was mostly controlled by Cedevita Ol.. Krka managed to win third quarter 21-18. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. They made 22-of-28 free shots (78.6 percent) during the game. 25 personal fouls committed by Krka helped opponents get some easy free throw opportunities. The best player for the winners was the former international Jaka Blazic (196-90) who scored 20 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists. American point guard Kendrick Perry (183-92, college: YSU) chipped in 18 points. Cedevita Ol.'s coach Jurica Golemac used a ten-player rotation which allowed the starters a little rest for the next games.
